note: A [separate dataset](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/intensity-of-multidimensional-poverty-hot) is produced to monitor trends over time.
title: Intensity of multidimensional poverty
subtitle: Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and living standards indicators. The intensity is the share of weighted indicators in which people in multidimensional poverty are deprived on average. Estimates based on the most recent household survey data.
